idea.title: Deep Salvage
idea.hook: Sweep an underwater detector across the dark seabed, follow the rising ping, fan sunken gold out of the silt, and surface before your air runs out - then upgrade your rig and dive deeper wrecks.
idea.title_ru_hook: Води подводным детектором по тёмному дну, иди на усиливающийся сигнал, выкапывай золото из ила и всплывай, пока не кончился воздух - улучшай снаряжение и ныряй глубже.
idea.prototype: underwater metal-detector salvage with air-as-resource press-your-luck + collection/upgrade meta
idea.mutation_of: the metal-detector treasure-sweep loop (192_treasure_sweep_web lineage), moved underwater and rebuilt around AIR as a consumable resource + a press-your-luck banking decision
idea.why_novel: differentiates from 192_treasure_sweep_web (a kiddie beach sandbox gated by an energy/stamina meter) by theme (dark deep-sea wrecks, procedural caustics + rising ping) and, critically, by PRESSURE: air is spent per dig and by depth, forcing a surface-now-or-dig-deeper gamble. No underwater detector / press-your-luck salvage existed in the portfolio.
idea.non_timer_pressure: AIR as a consumable resource (spent per fan/dig + ambient depth drain) + press-your-luck banking (surface safe vs greedier haul)
idea.lose_condition: air <= 0 during a dive -> forced ascent -> gs='GAMEOVER', lose 50% of the unbanked haul

synthesizer_brief: Manual idea from Tim: 'dig something out with metal detector'. Built as an underwater treasure-diver: handheld detector, rising ping over buried metal, fan the silt to recover sunken gold, manage a draining air supply, bank coins to upgrade the rig and unlock deeper, richer wrecks.

alternatives.title: Beachcomber Sweep
alternatives.hook: Sweep a modern beach with a metal detector, dig coins, rings and relics from the sand between the tide lines.
alternatives.why_novel: rejected: too close to the existing 192_treasure_sweep_web kiddie beach sandbox - same surface, no fresh pressure axis

alternatives.title: Bone Dig
alternatives.hook: Brush dino bones out of a desert dig site grid square by square and assemble the skeleton.
alternatives.why_novel: rejected: a brush-reveal grid is a different (slower, puzzle) verb than detector-sweep, and is off-theme from the metal-detector ask

alternatives.title: Mudlark Thames
alternatives.hook: Pick treasures out of the tidal river mud at low tide before the water comes back in.
alternatives.why_novel: rejected: the 'before the water returns' framing is a countdown timer, which violates the non-timer-pressure rule
